//go:build js && wasm

package client

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall/js"
	"time"

	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/internal/offlinejson"
	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/offline"
)

type offlineObserver struct {
	scope    *Scope
	callback func(OfflineState)
}

type offlineController struct {
	descriptor        offline.ClientDescriptor
	state             OfflineState
	busy              bool
	request           uint64
	confirmedDisabled bool
	nativeMode        bool
	conflictReason    string
	lastDisable       offlineDisableReceipt
	diag              OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic
}

var documentOffline *offlineController
var offlineObservers = map[*offlineObserver]struct{}{}

// OfflineStatus returns the most recently confirmed worker state. A saved page
// always describes public snapshot data; ordinary network actions are never
// queued or replayed by these APIs. This first control API is eager-core only.
func OfflineStatus() OfflineState {
	if moduleMode {
		return OfflineState{Phase: "unavailable", LastError: ErrOfflineUnsupported.Error()}
	}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	defer offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if documentOffline == nil {
		return OfflineState{Phase: "unavailable"}
	}
	return documentOffline.state
}

// RefreshOfflineStatus performs one explicit serialized status operation for
// the owned active and waiting workers, as applicable, and publishes a fresh
// snapshot. Unlike OfflineStatus, this is asynchronous: call
// from Scope.Go, never a JS event callback. It shares the single-operation
// admission/cancellation rules and never registers, updates or repairs a worker.
// An unconfirmed result is not automatically retried.
func RefreshOfflineStatus(ctx context.Context) error { return offlineOperation(ctx, "status") }

// SubscribeOffline immediately delivers a snapshot, including on unconfigured
// or unsupported documents. The callback must return promptly. Its subscription
// is removed with scope cleanup. Lazy-module controls are explicitly unsupported.
func SubscribeOffline(scope *Scope, callback func(OfflineState)) error {
	if moduleMode {
		return ErrOfflineUnsupported
	}
	if scope == nil || !scope.active() || callback == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("nextgo: offline subscription needs an active scope and callback")
	}
	observer := &offlineObserver{scope: scope, callback: callback}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	if len(offlineObservers) >= 128 {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		return ErrOfflineBusy
	}
	offlineObservers[observer] = struct{}{}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	scope.Cleanup(func() {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		delete(offlineObservers, observer)
		observer.callback, observer.scope = nil, nil
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	})
	deliverOffline(observer, OfflineStatus())
	return nil
}

func deliverOffline(observer *offlineObserver, state OfflineState) {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	_, present := offlineObservers[observer]
	callback, scope := observer.callback, observer.scope
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if !present || callback == nil || scope == nil || !scope.active() {
		return
	}
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			offlineQuiet(func() { report("offline status callback failed") })
		}
	}()
	callback(state)
}
func (c *offlineController) notify() {
	// Host reads can synchronously reenter. They happen before a protected
	// current-controller commit, and no observer runs with the mutex held.
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	if documentOffline != c { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return }
	descriptor, document, window := c.descriptor, doc, win
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	controlling := c.controlling()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	if documentOffline != c || c.descriptor != descriptor || !doc.Equal(document) || !win.Equal(window) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return }
	mode := c.state.Configured && (c.state.SavedDocument || controlling && (c.state.Enabled || !c.confirmedDisabled))
	changed := mode != c.nativeMode
	c.nativeMode, c.state.Controlling = mode, controlling
	state := c.state
	list := make([]*offlineObserver, 0, len(offlineObservers))
	for observer := range offlineObservers { list = append(list, observer) }
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if changed {
		if mode && currentURL != "" {
			cancelPendingNavigation()
			invalidateCache()
		}
		if !mode && viewportPrefetch != nil {
			viewportPrefetch.requestScan()
		}
	}
	for _, observer := range list {
		deliverOffline(observer, state)
	}
}

// EnableOffline explicitly requests saving only native-approved anonymous public
// pages. Call from Scope.Go or another goroutine, never a JS event callback.
func EnableOffline(ctx context.Context) error { return offlineOperation(ctx, "enable") }

// CheckOfflineUpdate asks the browser to check the owned registration. A waiting
// worker stays waiting: this API never calls skipWaiting or clients.claim, and
// never asks an old worker to install a new deployment under its old runtime.
func CheckOfflineUpdate(ctx context.Context) error { return offlineOperation(ctx, "update") }

// DisableOffline stops saved-document serving and unregisters the exact owner.
// Controlled pages can retain charged public payloads: CleanupPending reports
// that state. Later explicit reconciliation after those pages close is needed;
// unregistering is not a guaranteed background purge or private-data erase API.
func DisableOffline(ctx context.Context) error { return offlineOperation(ctx, "disable") }

func browserOfflineSupport() (supported bool) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			supported = false
		}
	}()
	secure := offlineJSGet(win, "isSecureContext")
	if secure.Type() != js.TypeBoolean || !secure.Bool() {
		return false
	}
	navigator := offlineJSGet(win, "navigator")
	if navigator.Type() != js.TypeObject || navigator.IsNull() {
		return false
	}
	sw, locks := offlineJSGet(navigator, "serviceWorker"), offlineJSGet(navigator, "locks")
	return sw.Type() == js.TypeObject && !sw.IsNull() && offlineJSGet(sw, "register").Type() == js.TypeFunction && offlineJSGet(sw, "getRegistrations").Type() == js.TypeFunction && locks.Type() == js.TypeObject && !locks.IsNull() && offlineJSGet(locks, "request").Type() == js.TypeFunction && offlineJSGet(win, "MessageChannel").Type() == js.TypeFunction
}

// initializeOfflineDocument runs only after normal deployment/configuration and
// document validation. Unconfigured pages perform no service-worker inspection.
func initializeOfflineDocument() (saved bool, err error) {
	var c *offlineController
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			err = ErrOfflineProtocol
			if c != nil {
				message := err.Error()
				offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
				c.state.LastError = message
				c.state.Phase = "error"
				offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			}
		}
	}()
	if moduleMode {
		return false, ErrOfflineUnsupported
	}
	body := offlineJSGet(doc, "body")
	raw := offlineJSCall(body, "getAttribute", offline.ClientDescriptorAttribute)
	marker := offlineJSCall(body, "getAttribute", "data-nextgo-offline-saved")
	if raw.IsNull() && marker.IsNull() {
		return false, nil
	}
	saved = !marker.IsNull()
	c = &offlineController{state: OfflineState{Phase: "unavailable", SavedDocument: saved}}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	documentOffline = c
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if raw.IsNull() || raw.Type() != js.TypeString || len(raw.String()) > offline.MaxClientDescriptorBytes || saved && marker.String() != "1" {
		return saved, ErrOfflineProtocol
	}
	var descriptor offline.ClientDescriptor
	if offlinejson.Decode([]byte(raw.String()), &descriptor) != nil || offline.ValidateClientDescriptor(descriptor, offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(win, "location"), "origin").String(), deployment.BasePath, offlineJSCall(body, "getAttribute", "data-nextgo-build").String(), offlineJSCall(body, "getAttribute", "data-nextgo-configuration").String()) != nil {
		return saved, ErrOfflineProtocol
	}
	supported := !routeManifest.Development && browserOfflineSupport() && offlineNativeReady()
	unsupportedMessage := ErrOfflineUnsupported.Error()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	committed := offlineCommitConfigurationLocked(c, descriptor, supported)
	if committed && !supported { c.state.LastError = unsupportedMessage }
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if !committed || !supported {
		return saved, nil
	}
	go func() { _ = offlineOperation(context.Background(), "status") }()
	return saved, nil
}

func offlineOperation(parent context.Context, command string) (err error) {
	if moduleMode {
		return ErrOfflineUnsupported
	}
	if parent == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("nextgo: offline operation needs a context")
	}
	if parent.Err() != nil {
		return context.Cause(parent)
	}
	limit := 120 * time.Second
	if command == "status" { limit = 5 * time.Second }
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parent, limit)
	defer cancel()
	authority, err := offlineAdmitOperation(ctx, command)
	if err != nil { return err }
	c := authority.c
	// This defer is installed immediately after admission, before notification
	// or any operation that may invoke a host/user callback.
	defer func() {
		if failure := recover(); failure != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("nextgo: offline browser operation failed")
		}
		message := ""
		if err != nil { message = offlineErrorText(err) }
		if err == ErrOfflineConflict {
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			reason := c.conflictReason
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			if reason != "" { message += " [" + reason + "]" }
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		c.busy = false
		if err != nil {
			c.state.Phase = "error"
			c.state.LastError = message
		}
		// A replaced document controller owns the current observer set. Retain
		// this operation's cleanup/error locally without publishing stale state.
		current := documentOffline == c
		// Physical cleanup knowledge is published by the realm owner only.
		offlineDiagnosticFinishLocked(&c.diag, c.diag.CleanupKnown)
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		if current { c.notify() }
	}()
	c.notify()
	use := offlineRegistrationMutation
	if command == "status" {
		use = offlineRegistrationStatus
	} else if command == "update" {
		use = offlineRegistrationUpdate
	} else if command == "disable" {
		use = offlineRegistrationDisable
	}
	selection, err := c.registrationForOperation(ctx, use)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if selection.emptyUpdate {
		result, e := c.updateInFreshRealm(ctx, selection.container, selection.parentController)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if e = result.parent.fence(ctx); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
		c.applyLocked(result.status)
		c.state.WaitingGeneration = result.waiting
		if result.waiting != "" {
			c.state.Phase = "waiting"
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}
	if selection.emptyDisable {
		result, e := c.disableInFreshRealm(ctx, selection.container, selection.parentController)
		return c.completeFreshDisable(ctx, result, e)
	}
	registration := selection.registration
	controllerOwned := c.controlling()
	if (command == "enable" || command == "disable" && !controllerOwned) && !registration.Truthy() {
		sw := offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(win, "navigator"), "serviceWorker")
		registration, err = c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(sw, "register", c.descriptor.WorkerURL, offlineJSObject(map[string]any{"scope": c.descriptor.Scope, "updateViaCache": "none", "type": "classic"})))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err = c.validateRegistration(registration); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if command == "update" {
		if !registration.Truthy() {
			return ErrOfflineUnavailable
		}
		if selection.recovered {
			if err = c.recoveredRegistrationFence(ctx, selection, js.Undefined(), false, "registration-proof-empty-update"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if _, err = c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(registration, "update")); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err = c.waitInstallation(ctx, registration); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	worker := selection.statusWorker
	if registration.Truthy() {
		worker = offlineJSGet(registration, "active")
		if !worker.Truthy() && (command == "enable" || command == "disable") {
			if err = c.waitActivation(ctx, registration); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			worker = offlineJSGet(registration, "active")
		}
	}
	if !worker.Truthy() {
		controller := offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(win, "navigator"), "serviceWorker"), "controller")
		if c.ownedWorker(controller) {
			worker = controller
		}
	}
	if worker.Truthy() {
		status, e := c.message(ctx, worker, "status", c.descriptor.RuntimeID, c.descriptor.ConfigurationID)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if command == "disable" {
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			current := authority.currentLocked(ctx)
			if current && offlineDisableReplyConfirmed(status) { c.applyLocked(status) }
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			if !current { return ErrOfflineUnknown }
		} else {
			if !authority.apply(ctx, status) { return ErrOfflineUnknown }
		}
		if !status.Supported {
			return ErrOfflineUnsupported
		}
		if command == "enable" || command == "disable" {
			if registration.Truthy() && offlineJSGet(registration, "active").Truthy() && !offlineJSGet(registration, "active").Equal(worker) {
				return c.ownershipConflict("active-worker-changed")
			}
			if command == "enable" {
				offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
				if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
				c.confirmedDisabled = false
				offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
				c.notify()
			}
			if selection.recovered {
				if err = c.recoveredRegistrationFence(ctx, selection, worker, true, "registration-proof-empty-message"); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			result, e := c.message(ctx, worker, command, status.RuntimeID, status.ConfigurationID)
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if command == "disable" {
				offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
				// Preserve authentic late facts before testing public authority.
				c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged = c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || offlineDisableAcknowledged(result)
				current := authority.currentLocked(ctx)
				offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
				if !current { return ErrOfflineUnknown }
				if !result.Supported {
					return ErrOfflineUnsupported
				}
			} else {
				if !authority.apply(ctx, result) { return ErrOfflineUnknown }
			}
			if result.Error != "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("nextgo: offline worker refused operation (%s)", result.Error)
			}
			if command == "enable" && (!result.Enabled || result.ActiveGeneration == "") {
				return ErrOfflineProtocol
			}
			if command == "disable" {
				if !offlineDisableAcknowledged(result) {
					return ErrOfflineProtocol
				}
				offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
				c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged = true
				if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
				c.applyLocked(result)
				offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			}
		}
	} else {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
		c.state.Enabled = false
		c.confirmedDisabled = true
		c.state.ActiveGeneration = ""
		c.state.Phase = "disabled"
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		if command == "enable" {
			return ErrOfflineUnknown
		}
	}
	if command == "disable" && registration.Truthy() {
		if selection.recovered {
			if err = c.recoveredRegistrationFence(ctx, selection, worker, true, "registration-proof-empty-unregister"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted = true
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		unregistered, unregisterErr := c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(registration, "unregister"))
		if unregisterErr != nil {
			return unregisterErr
		}
		if unregistered.Type() != js.TypeBoolean || !unregistered.Bool() {
			return ErrOfflineUnknown
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue = true
		if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
		c.state.Enabled = false
		if !c.state.CleanupPending {
			c.state.ActiveGeneration = ""
		}
		c.state.WaitingGeneration = ""
		c.state.Phase = "disabled"
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	}
	if command != "disable" && registration.Truthy() {
		waiting := offlineJSGet(registration, "waiting")
		if waiting.Truthy() {
			result, e := c.message(ctx, waiting, "status", c.descriptor.RuntimeID, c.descriptor.ConfigurationID)
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
			c.state.WaitingGeneration = result.Generation
			if c.state.WaitingGeneration != "" {
				c.state.Phase = "waiting"
			}
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		} else {
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			if !authority.currentLocked(ctx) { offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock(); return ErrOfflineUnknown }
			c.state.WaitingGeneration = ""
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Native receipts are historical knowledge even if logical authority was
// revoked. Current authority is required before either newly confirmed status
// or the later Disable acknowledgement can replace public state. A valid status
// remains the newest confirmed knowledge if control subsequently refuses.
func (c *offlineController) completeFreshDisable(ctx context.Context, result offlineFreshDisableResult, operationErr error) error {
	// The current attempt reset this receipt before admission. Its owned native
	// callbacks may already have recorded late settlement after an unknown host
	// return, so completion can add facts but cannot erase them. The global realm
	// lease prevents another operation from sharing this attempt's callback owner.
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged = c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || result.disableAcknowledged && offlineDisableAcknowledged(result.status)
	c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted = c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || result.unregisterAttempted
	c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue = c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue || result.unregisterResolvedTrue
	c.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent = c.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent || result.verifiedRegistryAbsent
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if result.hasConfirmedStatus || result.disableAcknowledged {
		if authorityErr := result.parent.fence(ctx); authorityErr != nil {
			return authorityErr
		}
		if result.hasConfirmedStatus && !offlineDisableReplyConfirmed(result.confirmedStatus) || result.disableAcknowledged && !offlineDisableAcknowledged(result.status) {
			return ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		if !offlineCurrentAuthorityLocked(c,result.parent.descriptor,result.parent.document,result.parent.window) || ctx.Err() != nil {
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			return ErrOfflineUnknown
		}
		if result.hasConfirmedStatus {
			c.applyLocked(result.confirmedStatus)
		}
		if result.disableAcknowledged {
			c.applyLocked(result.status)
		}
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	}
	if operationErr != nil {
		return operationErr
	}
	if !result.disableAcknowledged || !result.unregisterResolvedTrue || !result.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
		return ErrOfflineUnknown
	}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	if !offlineCurrentAuthorityLocked(c,result.parent.descriptor,result.parent.document,result.parent.window) || ctx.Err() != nil {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		return ErrOfflineUnknown
	}
	c.state.WaitingGeneration = ""
	c.state.Phase = "disabled"
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

// Registration/update promises cannot be aborted. Retain the single operation
// and its callbacks until physical settlement, even if its caller cancels. The
// worker separately retains its storage lease after a message port is closed.
func (c *offlineController) promise(ctx context.Context, promise js.Value) (js.Value, error) {
	controller := offlineJSNew(offlineJSGet(js.Global(), "AbortController"))
	value, err := awaitPhysicalBrowserPromise(ctx, promise, controller)
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return js.Undefined(), ErrOfflineUnknown
	}
	return value, err
}

// ownershipConflict records only a fixed diagnostic category. Keep returning
// the exact sentinel: ownership decisions and callers' error identity stay intact.
func (c *offlineController) ownershipConflict(reason string) error {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	c.conflictReason = reason
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	return ErrOfflineConflict
}

func (c *offlineController) ownedWorker(worker js.Value) bool {
	return worker.Type() == js.TypeObject && !worker.IsNull() && offlineJSGet(worker, "scriptURL").Type() == js.TypeString && offlineJSGet(worker, "scriptURL").String() == c.descriptor.WorkerURL
}
func (c *offlineController) controlling() (owned bool) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			owned = false
		}
	}()
	return c.ownedWorker(offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(win, "navigator"), "serviceWorker"), "controller"))
}

// A record with the exact scope but no worker slots does not prove ownership.
// Status may instead query an independently validated controller; mutations must
// still establish ownership from the registration itself.
type offlineRegistrationOwnership uint8

const (
	offlineRegistrationUnproven offlineRegistrationOwnership = iota
	offlineRegistrationOwned
)

func (c *offlineController) registrationOwnership(registration js.Value) (offlineRegistrationOwnership, error) {
	if registration.Type() != js.TypeObject || registration.IsNull() || offlineJSGet(registration, "scope").Type() != js.TypeString || offlineJSGet(registration, "scope").String() != c.descriptor.Scope {
		return offlineRegistrationUnproven, c.ownershipConflict("registration-scope")
	}
	provedWorker := false
	for _, key := range []string{"active", "waiting", "installing"} {
		worker := offlineJSGet(registration, key)
		if worker.Truthy() {
			provedWorker = true
		}
		if worker.Truthy() && !c.ownedWorker(worker) {
			return offlineRegistrationUnproven, c.ownershipConflict("registration-" + key + "-worker")
		}
	}
	if !provedWorker {
		return offlineRegistrationUnproven, nil
	}
	return offlineRegistrationOwned, nil
}

func (c *offlineController) validateRegistration(registration js.Value) error {
	ownership, err := c.registrationOwnership(registration)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ownership == offlineRegistrationUnproven {
		return c.ownershipConflict("registration-empty")
	}
	return nil
}

// statusWorker is read-only controller authority. A recovered registration has
// independent inventory/worker proof and uses synchronous pre-mutation fences.
type offlineRegistrationSelection struct {
	registration js.Value
	statusWorker js.Value
	container    js.Value
	recovered    bool
	// These indications are distinct needs for fresh proof, not registration
	// authority. Neither may be consumed by Enable or strict selection.
	emptyUpdate      bool
	emptyDisable     bool
	parentController js.Value
}

type offlineRegistrationUse uint8

const (
	offlineRegistrationStrict offlineRegistrationUse = iota
	offlineRegistrationStatus
	offlineRegistrationMutation
	offlineRegistrationUpdate
	offlineRegistrationDisable
)

type offlineRegistrationInventory struct {
	exact    js.Value
	unproven bool
}

func (c *offlineController) registration(ctx context.Context) (js.Value, error) {
	selection, err := c.registrationForOperation(ctx, offlineRegistrationStrict)
	if err != nil {
		return js.Undefined(), err
	}
	return selection.registration, nil
}

// Inspect every entry before permitting recovery. An empty exact record still
// counts as an overlap, so it cannot hide a later foreign owner or duplicate.
func (c *offlineController) inspectRegistrationInventory(registrations js.Value) (offlineRegistrationInventory, error) {
	inventory := offlineRegistrationInventory{exact: js.Undefined()}
	if registrations.Type() != js.TypeObject || registrations.IsNull() || offlineJSLength(registrations) > 64 {
		return inventory, c.ownershipConflict("registration-list")
	}
	for i := 0; i < offlineJSLength(registrations); i++ {
		registration := offlineJSIndex(registrations, i)
		scope := offlineJSGet(registration, "scope")
		if scope.Type() != js.TypeString {
			return inventory, c.ownershipConflict("registration-scope-type")
		}
		// Native scope matching is literal prefix matching, including reader2.
		if strings.HasPrefix(scope.String(), c.descriptor.Scope) || strings.HasPrefix(c.descriptor.Scope, scope.String()) {
			ownership, err := c.registrationOwnership(registration)
			if err != nil {
				return inventory, err
			}
			if inventory.exact.Truthy() {
				return inventory, c.ownershipConflict("registration-duplicate")
			}
			inventory.exact = registration
			inventory.unproven = ownership == offlineRegistrationUnproven
		}
	}
	return inventory, nil
}

func (c *offlineController) registrationController(sw js.Value) (js.Value, error) {
	controller := offlineJSGet(sw, "controller")
	if controller.Truthy() && !c.ownedWorker(controller) {
		return js.Undefined(), c.ownershipConflict("controller-worker")
	}
	return controller, nil
}

func (c *offlineController) registrationForOperation(ctx context.Context, use offlineRegistrationUse) (offlineRegistrationSelection, error) {
	sw := offlineJSGet(offlineJSGet(win, "navigator"), "serviceWorker")
	registrations, err := c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(sw, "getRegistrations"))
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	inventory, err := c.inspectRegistrationInventory(registrations)
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	controller, err := c.registrationController(sw)
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	if inventory.unproven {
		switch use {
		case offlineRegistrationStatus:
			if !controller.Truthy() {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, ErrOfflineUnavailable
			}
			return offlineRegistrationSelection{registration: js.Undefined(), statusWorker: controller}, nil
		case offlineRegistrationMutation:
			return c.reacquireRegistration(ctx, sw)
		case offlineRegistrationUpdate, offlineRegistrationDisable:
			return c.reacquireRegistrationForUse(ctx, sw, use, controller)
		default:
			return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-empty-selection")
		}
	}
	return offlineRegistrationSelection{registration: inventory.exact, statusWorker: js.Undefined()}, nil
}

func (c *offlineController) requireRegistrationProof(registration js.Value, emptyReason string) error {
	ownership, err := c.registrationOwnership(registration)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ownership != offlineRegistrationOwned {
		return c.ownershipConflict(emptyReason)
	}
	return nil
}

// One acquisition transaction: initial inventory, one exact-scope lookup, one
// final inventory. The same-environment native object map binds the lookup to
// the latest entry; no equality with the initial record or UA repair is assumed.
func (c *offlineController) reacquireRegistration(ctx context.Context, sw js.Value) (offlineRegistrationSelection, error) {
	return c.reacquireRegistrationForUse(ctx, sw, offlineRegistrationMutation, js.Undefined())
}

func (c *offlineController) reacquireRegistrationForUse(ctx context.Context, sw js.Value, use offlineRegistrationUse, parentController js.Value) (offlineRegistrationSelection, error) {
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, context.Cause(ctx)
	}
	if offlineJSGet(sw, "getRegistration").Type() != js.TypeFunction {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-proof-unavailable")
	}
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, context.Cause(ctx)
	}
	candidate, err := c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(sw, "getRegistration", c.descriptor.Scope))
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	if !candidate.Truthy() {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-proof-missing")
	}
	ownership, err := c.registrationOwnership(candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	if ownership == offlineRegistrationUnproven {
		if use == offlineRegistrationUpdate && parentController.Truthy() && c.ownedWorker(parentController) {
			return offlineRegistrationSelection{container: sw, parentController: parentController, emptyUpdate: true}, nil
		}
		if use == offlineRegistrationDisable && parentController.Truthy() && c.ownedWorker(parentController) {
			// Empty fields never grant mutation authority. Check the full final
			// parent inventory and same-environment target identity before
			// selecting the separate child-native proof transaction.
			registrations, readErr := c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(sw, "getRegistrations"))
			if readErr != nil {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, readErr
			}
			inventory, inspectErr := c.inspectRegistrationInventory(registrations)
			if inspectErr != nil {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, inspectErr
			}
			current, controllerErr := c.registrationController(sw)
			if controllerErr != nil {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, controllerErr
			}
			if !current.Truthy() || !current.Equal(parentController) {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("parent-controller-changed")
			}
			if !inventory.exact.Truthy() || !candidate.Equal(inventory.exact) {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-proof-changed")
			}
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, context.Cause(ctx)
			}
			return offlineRegistrationSelection{container: sw, parentController: parentController, emptyDisable: true}, nil
		}
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-proof-empty-lookup")
	}
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, context.Cause(ctx)
	}
	registrations, err := c.promise(ctx, offlineJSCall(sw, "getRegistrations"))
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	inventory, err := c.inspectRegistrationInventory(registrations)
	if err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	if _, err = c.registrationController(sw); err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	if !inventory.exact.Truthy() {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-proof-missing")
	}
	if !candidate.Equal(inventory.exact) {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, c.ownershipConflict("registration-proof-changed")
	}
	// Re-read strict fields AFTER the last awaited read and controller check.
	if err = c.requireRegistrationProof(candidate, "registration-proof-empty-final-inventory"); err != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, err
	}
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return offlineRegistrationSelection{}, context.Cause(ctx)
	}
	return offlineRegistrationSelection{registration: candidate, statusWorker: js.Undefined(), container: sw, recovered: true}, nil
}

// These synchronous fences protect the next recovered-path dispatch after an
// awaited message. They are not an atomic registry lock against other writers,
// nor a rollback of a worker message which has already completed.
func (c *offlineController) recoveredRegistrationFence(ctx context.Context, selection offlineRegistrationSelection, worker js.Value, requireActive bool, emptyReason string) error {
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return context.Cause(ctx)
	}
	if _, err := c.registrationController(selection.container); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := c.requireRegistrationProof(selection.registration, emptyReason); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if requireActive {
		active := offlineJSGet(selection.registration, "active")
		if !active.Truthy() || !active.Equal(worker) {
			return c.ownershipConflict("active-worker-changed")
		}
	}
	return context.Cause(ctx)
}

func (c *offlineController) waitInstallation(ctx context.Context, registration js.Value) error {
	worker := offlineJSGet(registration, "installing")
	if !worker.Truthy() {
		return c.validateRegistration(registration)
	}
	return c.waitWorker(ctx, worker, func(state string) bool { return state == "installed" || state == "activated" })
}

func (c *offlineController) waitActivation(ctx context.Context, registration js.Value) error {
	if active := offlineJSGet(registration, "active"); active.Truthy() {
		return c.validateRegistration(registration)
	}
	worker := offlineJSGet(registration, "installing")
	if !worker.Truthy() {
		return ErrOfflineUnavailable
	}
	if err := c.waitWorker(ctx, worker, func(state string) bool { return state == "activated" }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !offlineJSGet(registration, "active").Truthy() {
		return ErrOfflineUnavailable
	}
	return c.validateRegistration(registration)
}

func (c *offlineController) waitWorker(ctx context.Context, worker js.Value, complete func(string) bool) error {
	if !c.ownedWorker(worker) {
		return c.ownershipConflict("worker-state-target")
	}
	done := make(chan struct{}, 1)
	callback := js.FuncOf(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any {
		select {
		case done <- struct{}{}:
		default:
		}
		return nil
	})
	listening := false
	defer func() {
		if listening {
			offlineQuiet(func() { offlineJSCall(worker, "removeEventListener", "statechange", callback) })
		}
		callback.Release()
	}()
	offlineJSCall(worker, "addEventListener", "statechange", callback)
	listening = true
	for {
		state := offlineJSGet(worker, "state").String()
		if state == "redundant" {
			return ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
		if complete(state) {
			return nil
		}
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ErrOfflineUnknown
		}
	}
}

func offlineQuiet(fn func()) { defer func() { _ = recover() }(); fn() }

// Caller-supplied cancellation causes may implement Error with application
// code. Formatting happens outside the authority mutex and cannot skip cleanup.
func offlineErrorText(err error) (message string) {
	message = "nextgo: offline browser operation failed"
	defer func() { _ = recover() }()
	if err != nil { message = err.Error() }
	return message
}

func (c *offlineController) apply(reply offlineReply) {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	c.applyLocked(reply)
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
}

// Caller holds offlineAuthorityMu. Reply validation and host authority probes
// precede entry; this is only a portable confirmed-state assignment.
func (c *offlineController) applyLocked(reply offlineReply) {
	c.confirmedDisabled = reply.State == "disabled" && !reply.Enabled
	c.state.CleanupPending = reply.DeferredCleanup
	c.state.Supported = reply.Supported
	c.state.Enabled = reply.Enabled
	c.state.ActiveGeneration = reply.ActiveGeneration
	c.state.WaitingGeneration = reply.StagingGeneration
	switch reply.State {
	case "staged":
		c.state.Phase = "waiting"
	case "failed":
		c.state.Phase = "error"
	case "busy":
		c.state.Phase = "busy"
	default:
		c.state.Phase = reply.State
	}
	if reply.Error != "" {
		c.state.LastError = reply.Error
	}
}

func (c *offlineController) message(ctx context.Context, worker js.Value, command, runtime, configuration string) (reply offlineReply, err error) {
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return reply, context.Cause(ctx)
	}
	if !c.ownedWorker(worker) {
		return reply, c.ownershipConflict("message-worker")
	}
	sequence, owner, reserveErr := c.reserveOfflineRequest()
	if reserveErr != nil { return reply, reserveErr }
	request := offlineRequest{Version: offlineMessageVersion, Command: command, OwnerPolicyID: owner, RuntimeID: runtime, ConfigurationID: configuration, RequestID: "offline-" + strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 36)}
	channel := offlineJSNew(offlineJSGet(win, "MessageChannel"))
	port := offlineJSGet(channel, "port1")
	other := offlineJSGet(channel, "port2")
	type result struct {
		reply offlineReply
		err   error
	}
	received := make(chan result, 1)
	callback := js.FuncOf(func(_ js.Value, args []js.Value) any {
		value := result{err: ErrOfflineProtocol}
		value.reply, value.err = decodeOfflineEvent(args, request)
		select {
		case received <- value:
		default:
		}
		return nil
	})
	listening := false
	defer func() {
		if listening {
			offlineQuiet(func() { offlineJSCall(port, "removeEventListener", "message", callback) })
		}
		offlineQuiet(func() { offlineJSCall(port, "close") })
		offlineQuiet(func() { offlineJSCall(other, "close") })
		callback.Release()
	}()
	offlineJSCall(port, "addEventListener", "message", callback, offlineJSObject(map[string]any{"once": true}))
	listening = true
	offlineJSCall(port, "start")
	offlineJSCall(worker, "postMessage", offlineJSRequest(request), offlineJSArray([]any{other}))
	select {
	case value := <-received:
		return value.reply, value.err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return reply, ErrOfflineUnknown
	}
}

// Inspect the fixed scalar shape before copying strings or marshaling. The
// transferred private port is dedicated to one bounded status/control reply.
func decodeOfflineMessage(value js.Value, request offlineRequest) (reply offlineReply, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			reply, err = offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
	}()
	if value.Type() != js.TypeObject || value.IsNull() || offlineJSLength(offlineJSCall(offlineJSGet(js.Global(), "Object"), "keys", value)) != 16 {
		return offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
	}
	object := map[string]any{}
	for _, key := range []string{"requestID", "ownerPolicyID", "runtimeID", "configurationID", "generation", "activeGeneration", "previousGeneration", "stagingGeneration", "state", "error"} {
		v := offlineJSGet(value, key)
		if v.Type() != js.TypeString || offlineJSGet(offlineJSInvoke(offlineJSGet(js.Global(), "Object"), v), "length").Int() > 64 {
			return offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
		object[key] = v.String()
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"enabled", "supported", "deferredCleanup"} {
		v := offlineJSGet(value, key)
		if v.Type() != js.TypeBoolean {
			return offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
		object[key] = v.Bool()
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"version", "savedAtUnix", "highestObservedUnix"} {
		v := offlineJSGet(value, key)
		if v.Type() != js.TypeNumber {
			return offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
		n := v.Float()
		if n < 0 || n > 1<<53-1 || n != float64(int64(n)) {
			return offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
		object[key] = int64(n)
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(object)
	if err != nil {
		return offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
	}
	return decodeOfflineReply(raw, request)
}

func savedOfflineHydrate() {
	// currentURL deliberately remains unset. Core/module Navigate, Refresh and
	// Prefetch therefore cannot fetch or commit a JSON navigation envelope.
	// Native anchors, history and forms remain browser/service-worker documents.
	installMotionPreference()
	hydrate()
}

// A saved document stays native even after Disable until a new document loads.
// A normal document with an owned controller is conservative until an owned
// status confirms Disabled; opt-out/uncontrolled documents retain their router.
func offlineNativeNavigation() bool {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	c := documentOffline
	if c == nil || !c.state.Configured {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		return false
	}
	if c.state.SavedDocument {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		return true
	}
	descriptor, document, window := c.descriptor, doc, win
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	controlling := c.controlling()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	current := documentOffline == c && c.state.Configured && c.descriptor == descriptor && doc.Equal(document) && win.Equal(window)
	mode := current && (c.state.SavedDocument || controlling && (c.state.Enabled || !c.confirmedDisabled))
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	return mode
}

func offlineNavigate(target string, replace bool) (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("nextgo: invalid native document navigation")
		}
	}()
	u := offlineJSNew(offlineJSGet(win, "URL"), target, offlineJSGet(doc, "baseURI"))
	if !eligibleURL(u) {
		return fmt.Errorf("navigation requires a same-origin page URL without credentials")
	}
	cancelPendingNavigation()
	if replace {
		offlineJSCall(offlineJSGet(win, "location"), "replace", offlineJSGet(u, "href").String())
	} else {
		offlineJSCall(offlineJSGet(win, "location"), "assign", offlineJSGet(u, "href").String())
	}
	return nil
}
